entries.scope: Required VS Code extension registry and operator guidance
entries.rationale: Adding ms-vscode.powershell changes the cross-platform required editor-extension contract and must be visible in the maintenance references and shared agent guidance.
entries.navigationImpact: Existing maintenance and agent-guidance paths remain unchanged and now describe the eighth required extension.
entries.languageStrategy: German first with English content immediately following in every changed user-facing surface.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The shared registry is consumed by the macOS/Linux Bash and Windows PowerShell maintainers; contract tests verify the exact eight-extension set and every binding documentation surface.
entries.risk: A missing or inconsistently documented required extension would leave PowerShell authoring and debugging outside the maintained editor baseline.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The required editor, PowerShell authoring policy, extension publisher, registry schema, or maintenance distribution contract changes.
